-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Api.WsTxnSteps` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def mvcc.WsNames.withPhys (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : mvcc.WsNames :=
  { st := γ.st.withPhys p, wmeta := γ.wmeta, wlog := γ.wlog, wst := γ.wst, wt := γ.wt, rel := γ.rel, tag := γ.tag }

def mvcc.slotYc (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(mvcc.api.absPart γ.api (Qp.half 1).half L c ∗
      mvcc.api.pndPart γ.api (mvcc.pndW γ) none ∗ mvcc.rcvW γ (Qp.half 1) c ∗ mvcc.api.wcrPart γ.api (Qp.half 1) c)

theorem mvcc.wsEndCbY_cons_iff (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (h :
    pend ≠ []) (crev : Int) (R : IProp GF) : mvcc.wsEndCbY γ ilog pend crev R ⊣⊢ (mvcc.idxSealed
    γ.st.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗ mvcc.slotYc γ.st ilog crev ∗ mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 ilog ={⊤}=∗
    mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ ∃ Y, Y ∗ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog pend crev Y
    iprop(mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R))

def mvcc.wsEndCbY (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (crev : Int) (R :
    IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  if pend = [] then mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog [] crev (mvcc.slotYc γ.st ilog crev) R
  else
    iprop(mvcc.idxSealed γ.st.idx (ilog ++ [pend]) -∗
        mvcc.slotYc γ.st ilog crev ∗ mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 ilog ={⊤}=∗
          mvcc.api.nlLb γ.st.api (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗
            ∃ Y, Y ∗ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog pend crev Y iprop(mvcc.wsSlot γ 1 (ilog ++ [pend]) ∗ R))

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore_takeYc (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (sealed : Bool) (crev : Int)
    (Z : IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps sealed crev Z
    ld ⊢ mvcc.slotYc γ ilog crev ∗ ∀ Y, Y -∗ mvcc.storeTxnWriteCoreY tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps
    sealed crev Z ld Y

theorem mvcc.isWatchTxnWriteT_tr (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (ld : Bool) (Tr : IProp GF)
    : mvcc.isWatchTxnWriteT tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld Tr ⊢ Tr ∗ ∀ Tr',
    Tr' -∗ mvcc.isWatchTxnWriteT tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld Tr'

theorem mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore_room (tw s : Loc) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog :
    mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (chs : GoSlice) (ps : List Loc) (b : Bool) (crev : Int) (Z :
    IProp GF) (ld : Bool) : mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps b crev Z ld ⊢
    mvcc.storeTxnWriteCore tw s γ trace ilog pend chs ps b crev Z ld ∗ ⌜List.length ilog + 4 ≤ 2 ^
    63⌝

theorem mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite_T (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log)
    (pend : List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (ld : Bool) :
    mvcc.isWatchTxnWrite tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld =
    mvcc.isWatchTxnWriteT tw s st γ trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev ld iprop(∃ te,
    traceutil.ownTrace trace te)

theorem mvcc.wsEndCbY_nil_iff (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (crev : Int) (R : IProp GF) :
    mvcc.wsEndCbY γ ilog [] crev R ⊣⊢ mvcc.endCb γ.st ilog [] crev (mvcc.slotYc γ.st ilog crev) R

theorem mvcc.slotYc_slotY (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) : mvcc.slotYc γ L c ⊢
    mvcc.slotY γ L

theorem mvcc.WsNames.withPhys_st (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) : (γ.withPhys p).st =
    γ.st.withPhys p

def mvcc.isWatchTxnWriteT (tw s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (trace : Loc) (ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend :
    List mvcc.Change) (puts deletes putSize : w64) (crev : Int) (ld : Bool) (Tr : IProp GF) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ mw,
      "#Htw" ∷
          typedPointsto tw
            {
              TxnWrite' :=
                interface.mkOk go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.metricsTxnWrite.ty.PointerType (intoVal mw),
              s' := s }
            DFrac.discard ∗
        "#Hws" ∷ mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ ∗
          "Htx" ∷ mvcc.isTxnWriteT mw st γ.st trace ilog pend puts deletes putSize crev iprop(True) ld Tr ∗
            "#Hcert" ∷ mvcc.idxCert γ.st.idx ilog)

theorem mvcc.isWatchableStore_withPhys (s st : Loc) (γ : mvcc.WsNames) (p : mvcc.PhysNames) :
    mvcc.isWatchableStore s st (γ.withPhys p) = mvcc.isWatchableStore s st γ
